breathing_exercises.name: 4-7-8 Breathing
breathing_exercises.description: A simple but powerful relaxation technique
steps: Inhale through your nose for 4 seconds
Exhale slowly through your mouth for 8 seconds

breathing_exercises.name: Box Breathing
breathing_exercises.description: Used by Navy SEALs to stay calm under pressure
steps: Wait for 4 seconds before inhaling again

breathing_exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent
Place one hand on your chest, one on your belly
Breathe in through your nose, letting your belly rise
Breathe out through pursed lips, letting your belly fall
